heading: How CI is performing
overview_label: Job execution and runner wait times
empty_comparison: No successful pipelines are available for comparison on this branch.
prestart_explanation: “Other pre-start time” is the interval from creation to start, excluding the queue. It may include waiting for earlier stages; these data do not establish the cause.
no_successes: No successful pipelines are available for timing comparison.
attention_one: {count} job needs attention: timings have increased.
attention_many: {count} jobs need attention: timings have increased.
not_enough: Not enough independent observations to compare yet.
limited_data: No regressions exceed the threshold. Data are limited for {count} jobs.
no_regressions: No regressions exceed the selected threshold.
earlier_successes: The comparison below uses earlier successful pipelines.
one_observation: One run is an observation, not an established trend.
unknown_purpose: Purpose is not documented in the verified catalog.
method_timings: Timings compare successful attempts in successful pipelines on the same branch. N counts measured attempts: current sample / baseline. P50 is the median; P95 helps identify long runs.
method_threshold: Threshold: P50 increased by at least {percent}% and {seconds} s. Requires at least {baseline} baseline observations and {current} current observations. This is an observed change, not proof of its cause.
method_fields: Execution and queue time come from separate GitLab API fields. Their sum may differ from the full creation-to-completion interval. Adding the times of parallel jobs does not give pipeline duration.
method_snapshot: These data are a snapshot; automatic refresh is off. Dates use {timezone}. {baseline}
baseline_history: Baseline: earlier successful pipelines in the same snapshot.
pipeline_caption: {count} successful pipelines. Queue time ends when CI first starts; per-job runner wait is shown in the table. Bar height is execution + queue, not the full creation-to-completion interval.
empty_chart: No successful pipelines are available for this chart.
pipeline_chart_label: CI execution and initial queue time for successful pipelines
empty_attempts: No successful attempts have measured timings.
history_label: Execution and runner wait for recent successful attempts
history_summary: {count} attempts: {from} — {to}. Bar height is execution + queue; missing measurements are shown in the table below.
job_context: Stage: {stage}. Total execution in the current sample: {execution}, queue: {queue}. Execution P95: {execution_p95} / {baseline_execution_p95} baseline. Queue P95: {queue_p95} / {baseline_queue_p95}. Extra attempts: {reruns} / {baseline_reruns}.
coverage: {attempts} attempts / {pipelines} pipelines. {active} unfinished. Available Jobs API history; erased and trigger jobs are excluded.
release_heading: Release history across selected refs / tags
release_scope: Explicitly selected refs: {refs}. Exploratory cross-ref history from the current snapshot; the same-ref comparison remains separate.
release_empty_jobs: No job attempts are available for the selected refs.
release_exploratory: Exploratory comparison across selected refs. A duration change does not establish a regression or its cause.
release_no_change: No change exceeds the selected threshold
release_metric: {label}: current P50 {current_time} / baseline P50 {baseline_time}; measured attempts N {current_n} / {baseline_n}; missing {current_missing} / {baseline_missing}. {change}{delta}.
release_sample_ids: Current pipeline IDs: {current_pipelines}; baseline pipeline IDs: {baseline_pipelines}. Current attempts: {current_attempts}; baseline attempts: {baseline_attempts}.
no_context_differences: no differences detected in available fields
release_context: Context: {differences}. Job configuration, image and cache are not verified across releases. {limitations}Current sources: {current_sources}; baseline sources: {baseline_sources}. Current runner IDs: {current_runners}; baseline runner IDs: {baseline_runners}.
release_chart_note: {visible} visible attempts of {selected} selected attempts; ordered by pipeline creation time. Units: {unit}. Queue is above execution. Unknown components are marked ?, not measured as zero. Failed/canceled attempts remain visible; only successful attempts in successful pipelines enter the comparison. Comparison samples may extend beyond this visible attempt window.
release_chart_label: Release job execution and runner queue, {unit}
release_selected: Ref: {ref} · {date} · job {job_status} / pipeline {pipeline_status}. Runner queue {queue}; execution {execution}.
release_eligible: Eligible for successful timing cohorts when its measurement is available.
